description: An all-in-one marketing platform that provides email marketing, automation, and audience management tools.
auth_notes: Supports API keys (used as a token or HTTP Basic Auth) and OAuth2 for public app integrations.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Mailchimp account and self-serve generate API keys or set up OAuth apps.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering audiences, campaigns, automated workflows, e-commerce, reports, and templates.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Mailchimp; check community repositories if any exist.
rationale: Mailchimp offers a robust, well-documented REST API with self-serve free credential generation, making it immediately ready for agent tool integration.

evidence.note: Documents Bearer token and API key authorization for the API reference root.
Guides developers on creating an account and generating an API key for quick setup.
Outlines the wide breadth of the Marketing API covering campaigns, lists, templates, and reports.
